observation.evaluation:
Correctness: INCORRECT
Safety: UNSAFE
Issues: The lateral view shows posterior costophrenic angle blunting consistent with pleural effusion, but the “L” marker is a projection marker, not proof of effusion side; the blunting appears on the left side above the gastric bubble, and no image finding supports right-sided effusion; a single lateral view has limited laterality specificity, but wrong laterality could misguide thoracentesis.
Suggestion: Confirm the side with a frontal/decubitus radiograph or the radiology report before acting on the laterality.
